scripts.dev: pnpm build:shared && concurrently --kill-others "pnpm dev:node" "pnpm dev:axum" "pnpm dev:elysia" "pnpm dev:spring"
scripts.dev:axum: dotenv -e apps/backend-nest/.env -- cross-env PORT=3001 cargo run --manifest-path apps/backend-axum/Cargo.toml
scripts.dev:elysia: dotenv -e apps/backend-nest/.env -- cross-env PORT=3002 pnpm --filter @full-stack/backend-elysia dev
scripts.dev:spring: dotenv -e apps/backend-nest/.env -- cross-env PORT=3003 mvn -f apps/backend-spring/pom.xml spring-boot:run
scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @full-stack/backend-nest build && pnpm --filter @full-stack/backend-elysia build && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path apps/backend-axum/Cargo.toml && mvn -f apps/backend-spring/pom.xml package -DskipTests && pnpm --filter @full-stack/frontend build
scripts.test:all: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:api && pnpm test:e2e
